Leave Employees Settings

Open decision: balance-setting access

This has to be settled by the product owner before this story can be scheduled for build.

⚠

Blocker: who may set or adjust a starting leave balance?

The story description names two candidate answers — HR only, or HR and the employee's manager — without picking one. Until Product confirms a single answer, engineering has nothing to build the permission check against.

Option A: HR only

The narrower rule. Managers can view an employee's balances in a request or approval view (AC4) but cannot create or change them.

  • HR: can set and adjust balances
  • Manager: view-only
  • Team member: view-only, own balance

Option B: HR + Manager

The broader rule. A direct manager can set up or correct their own report's balance without routing through HR first.

  • HR: can set and adjust balances
  • Manager: can set and adjust balances for their reports
  • Team member: view-only, own balance

What's already certain, regardless of which option is chosen

ActionHRManagerTeam member
View current balance in a request or approval viewAllowedAllowedAllowed (own)
Set starting balances for a newly onboarded employeeAllowedPending decisionNot allowed
Adjust an existing balanceAllowedPending decisionNot allowed

Go to "Balances" and switch "Previewing access policy" to compare the Manager row's experience under Option A and Option B directly.

Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

All three leave types are always available — AC1

On "Leave types", pick any employee from "Preview available types for" — annual, sick, and unpaid are always the three types returned, regardless of who's selected.

2

Onboarded employees get a starting balance per type — AC2

On "Balances", click "Set starting balances" on Priya Shah's row (onboarding complete, no balances yet), enter a value for each of the three types, and save — all three are recorded immediately.

3

No starting balance exists before onboarding is complete — AC3

Devon Ruiz (in progress) and Taylor Kim (not started) show "No starting balance exists" with no action available on "Balances", and a disabled request form with the same explanation on "Request time off".

4

Current balance per type is shown in request and approval views — AC4

"Request time off" (viewing as Jordan Reyes or Morgan Blake) and "Approve leave request" (Jordan Reyes's pending request) both show the employee's current balance per leave type inline, before any decision is made.

⚠

Unresolved blocker — not covered by any AC above.

Who may set or adjust a balance (HR only vs. HR + Manager) is still undecided. See "Open decision: balance-setting access". This story should not move to build until that's answered.
